data.name: DeCarbo Cleantech Private Limited
data.description: DeCarbo Cleantech Private Limited is an Indian startup that turns agricultural waste into biochar for carbon removal and soil use. It is developing what it calls India's first integrated biochar park on a 27-acre site and is raising a seed round of about €500k.
